     - The function `__spiTranslate32()` was changed to be marked as `static`, indicating that it is only used within this file.

2. **General Changes**:
   - All local functions in the `esp32-hal-xpi.c` module were audited to ensure they are marked as `static` if they are not used outside the module.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications are interconnected as they collectively aim to improve code quality and reduce compiler warnings. The removal of the unused `__spiTranslate24()` function helps clean up the codebase, while marking functions as `static` limits their visibility and potential conflicts with other modules. The change to `__spiTransferBytes()` to accept `const uint8_t *` ensures that the function adheres to best practices regarding read-only data, addressing a specific warning that arose from previous changes. Overall, these modifications enhance the maintainability and reliability of the SPI implementation in the ESP32 core.

* SPI: Fix discarded-qalifiers warning when compiling with all warnings

This fixes an error introduced with changeset b847f41 which
tightened the use of const for read-only data. The helper
funtion __transferBytes also requires the const qualifier on
outgoing data. Without this change a warning is displayed
when compiling with the Arduino IDE set to display "All"
compiler warnings.

Tests:
 - Build an ESP32 SPI sketch that uses static const data to send
   to an SPI device using the SPI.transferBytes() API

* SPI:Ensure all local functions are marked static

This audits all functions in the esp32-hal-xpi.c module and
ensures that any functions entirely local to the module are
marked as static.

Tests:
 - Build with Arduino set to show all warnings and ensure none
   are displayed
